policy: Prior 8 active first-step exact forecast results; minimum 4 active samples. Accept >=75%, reject <=50%, hold otherwise. Reject and hold use greedy release. Jointly quiet forecast/actual excluded. Gate evaluated before actual observation.
limitations: Thresholds fixed provisionally, not independently calibrated; exact matching may be too strict for noisy predictable signals. Same synthetic suite as 159H, not independent holdout. Two-step predictive accuracy not directly calibrated.
